user.title: Choose a Plex server
user.description: Plex Stream Bridge uses the connection of a server already set up in the Plex integration.

data_description.server_id: The Plex Media Server, as set up in the Plex integration, whose libraries the channels play from.

abort.already_configured: This Plex server already has Plex Stream Bridge channels.
abort.no_plex_servers: No unconfigured Plex servers found. Set up and load the Plex integration first.

data.reencode_video: Re-encode video for smooth WebRTC playback
data.local_url: Home Assistant URL for the stream worker

data_description.channels: Each channel is a camera and a media player that play one video at a time.
data_description.reencode_video: Removes B-frames, which WebRTC (the default camera player) cannot play smoothly. Uses about one CPU core on the Home Assistant host while someone is watching. Turn off to pass Plex's video through unchanged.
data_description.local_url: Leave empty to use the address Home Assistant listens on (127.0.0.1 by default). Only needed if Home Assistant cannot reach itself that way.

plex_entry_missing.message: The Plex server this entry uses is no longer set up in the Plex integration.

plex_not_loaded.message: The Plex integration has not finished loading this server.

server_unavailable.message: The Plex server is not currently connected.

not_plex_media.message: {media_id} is not Plex media. Use a plex:// media ID, for example from the media browser.

unsupported_media.message: Plex {type} items cannot be played on a channel; choose a movie, show, season or episode.

lookup_failed.message: Could not look up the Plex media: {error}

transcode_refused.message: Plex refused to transcode the media (HTTP {status}).

ffmpeg_missing.message: ffmpeg was not found at {binary}. Install ffmpeg (or set ffmpeg_bin in the ffmpeg configuration) and restart Home Assistant.

ffmpeg_unsupported.message: ffmpeg at {binary} cannot encode H.264 with libx264, which Plex Stream Bridge needs. Install an ffmpeg build with libx264 and restart Home Assistant.
